# LedgerAlps

> LedgerAlps is a 100% on-premise, free, and open-source Swiss invoicing desktop application designed for Swiss freelancers, craftsmen, self-employed professionals, and SMEs. It natively generates official Swiss QR-Bills (QR-Facture / QR-Rechnung) compliant with SIX Payment Standards (SPS v2.3) and Swiss data protection laws (nLPD / FADP).

## Key Facts & Capabilities

- **Product Name:** LedgerAlps
- **Category:** Accounting & Invoicing Software (Logiciel de facturation suisse)
- **Target Market:** Switzerland (CH) — Self-employed, Freelancers, SMEs, Craftsmen
- **Pricing:** 100% Free & Open Source (No subscription, 0 CHF, no hidden fees, unlimited invoices & clients)
- **Deployment Architecture:** 100% On-Premise / Local Desktop Application (No cloud required, offline-first, zero telemetry, local encrypted database)
- **Supported Operating Systems:** Windows 10, Windows 11 (64-bit x64)
- **Official Website:** https://ledgeralps.ch
- **Official GitHub Repository:** https://github.com/kmdn-ch/LedgerAlps
- **Latest Windows Installer:** https://github.com/kmdn-ch/LedgerAlps/releases/latest/download/LedgerAlps-Setup-x64.exe

## Swiss Regulatory & Banking Compliance

- **SIX Payment Standards (SPS v2.3):** Full native generation of Swiss QR-Bills with Swiss QR-Code, central Swiss cross, structured QR-Reference with recursive Modulo 10 check digit (27 digits), support for QR-IBAN and standard IBAN in CHF and EUR.
- **Swiss Data Protection Act (nLPD / revDSG / FADP):** 100% on-premise storage ensures zero cross-border data transfer, immune to the US CLOUD Act.
- **Swiss Code of Obligations (Art. 957 to 958f CO / OR):** Meets the mandatory 10-year digital retention and archiving standards for accounting records.
- **Swiss VAT Rates (TVA / MWST):** Native support for standard rate (8.1%), reduced rate (2.6%), and accommodation special rate (3.8%), with custom VAT configuration.

## Core Features

- **Financial Dashboard:** Real-time revenue tracking, overdue invoice monitoring, payment collection rates.
- **Swiss Invoice Editor:** Instant invoice composition, automatic VAT calculation, high-resolution vector PDF export with official QR payment slip.
- **Client Directory:** Local CRM and debtor management with Swiss UID/IDE business numbers.
- **Item & Service Catalog:** Predefined pricing, Swiss VAT rate assignment, unit management.
- **Company & Banking Settings:** Direct configuration of legal business name, QR-IBAN, standard IBAN, UID (e.g., CHE-123.456.789 TVA).
- **Data Portability & Backup:** One-click backup export to USB keys, external hard drives, or local NAS.
